note: NOERROR, THE ARGUMENT THE THIRD SLOT IS FOR. Emacs answers (nil nil): a missing feature with NOERROR non-nil returns nil instead of raising, and nothing is provided as a side effect. This is the guarded-require idiom every package writes (`(require \'foo nil t)'), and it is `cython-mode''s first blocker. U.1a added the slot and kg answers this too.
